description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

MSI Metro Sales Inc. is hiring a Software Developer for its Managed IT team in Roseville, Minnesota. The role builds and maintains AI integrations, internal applications, APIs, and workflow automations, while collaborating with technicians, Service Desk, and sales staff.
Software Developer building MCP connectors, internal apps and APIs, n8n workflows, and LLM features

Responsibilities:
• Build, maintain, verify and secure connectors (MCP servers) that let AI systems work with the internal software stack Build against vendor REST and GraphQL APIs
• Develop from written specs and ship the docs with the code: READMEs, PRDs, decision records, and runbooks
• Develop and maintain n8n workflows for internal and external flows that move data between ConnectWise, N-central, IT Glue, and Microsoft Teams, with dry runs before live changes, error handling, and failure alerts
• Ship features and fixes across our internal apps and APIs, from database migration to UI. Ship changes through a GitHub with tests and code review
• Use Claude Code daily to plan, write, review, and test code, and critically evaluate its output
• Protect credentials and client data with read-only defaults, least privilege, and secrets stored in Key Vault, never in git, logs, or chat
• Partner with technicians, Service Desk, and sales staff to drive improvements
• Enhance our LLM features: prompts, retrieval quality, similarity thresholds, and the guardrails that keep agent output limited to valid values
• Other duties as required

Requirements:
• High school diploma, GED, or equivalent with 1+ year(s) of professional software development or a portfolio of shipped work (internships, open source, freelance, or personal projects with real users), or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent
• 1+ year (or equivalent coursework) integrating REST APIs (authentication, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and writing SQL in PostgreSQL or SQL Server
• Python: packaging and virtual environments, type hints, HTTP clients, pytest
• Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests, code review, reading a failed CI run
• Command line: PowerShell and Bash
• SQL: joins, indexes, schema migrations
• A second language, ideally TypeScript or C#
• Versed in security basics: keeping secrets out of source control, how OAuth/OIDC sign-in works at a high level
• Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S without requiring sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred:
• Experience building MCP servers, Claude skills, or AI agents that use tools, LLM APIs or AI coding assistants
• Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and measuring whether retrieval improves output
• Azure: Container Apps, Key Vault, Entra ID app registrations, Application Insights, or infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform
• Exposure to workflow automation in n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools and Docker and GitHub Actions pipelines
• MSP platforms: ConnectWise Manage, N-central, IT Glue, Huntress, or SentinelOne
• Web development with React and a Node backend (Fastify or Express) and an ORM such as Drizzle or Prisma
• C# and .NET beyond the basics: ASP.NET Core web APIs, WPF desktop apps, or PowerShell modules tested with Pester
• Supported Help desk, networking, or systems administration
• OpenTelemetry or other observability tooling
• Strong written communication, including clear documentation and pull request descriptions
• Candidates with a shareable link of the code written (GitHub, a portfolio, or a project write-up) any builds with an LLM or AI coding tool, will be prioritized
